internal.title: Incident Report: Cart Service Error Rate Spike Due to Feature Flag Issue
internal.body:
At 10:39 UTC on 2026-11-08, the cart service triggered a high error rate alert. Investigation identified that the cartFailure feature flag was causing Valkey connection errors, leading to service failures. The flag was disabled at 10:59 UTC, resulting in immediate recovery and normalization of error rates. The incident was resolved promptly with no lasting impact on service availability.

Timeline:
- 10:39 UTC: Alert received for high error rate in cart service.
- 10:59 UTC: Diagnosis confirmed cartFailure flag as root cause.
- 10:59 UTC: Flag disabled after approval.
- 10:59 UTC: Recovery verified with error rates returning to normal.

Action Taken:
- Disabled the cartFailure feature flag to restore service functionality.

Please review the postmortem for detailed analysis and lessons learned.

external.title: Some customers experienced issues with cart service
external.body: Between 10:39 and 10:59 UTC on 2026-11-08, some customers experienced issues with the cart service due to an internal configuration error. The issue was identified and resolved quickly by our operations team, and normal service was restored. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and are taking steps to prevent similar issues in the future.

output.summary: The cart service experienced a spike in error rates due to an active feature flag causing connection errors. Disabling the flag resolved the issue.
output.impact: Some customers were unable to use the cart service between 10:39 and 10:59 UTC, potentially affecting their shopping experience.
output.root_cause: An active feature flag (cartFailure) caused Valkey connection errors in the cart service, leading to increased error rates.
output.resolution: The cartFailure feature flag was disabled, which immediately restored normal service operation and reduced error rates to baseline levels.

lessons.lesson: Feature flags that can cause service disruptions should have stricter controls and automated rollback mechanisms to minimize impact.
lessons.applies_when: When the cartFailure feature flag is active and causing service errors.

action_items: Implement automated monitoring and rollback for critical feature flags.
Review and improve feature flag deployment and approval processes.
